hero3.h1: $109 new patient visit at your local Arvada dentist.
hero3.hero-lead: A comprehensive exam, digital X-rays, an oral cancer screening and a treatment plan you actually get talked through, with a doctor, not a leaflet. On Wadsworth Boulevard, with parking at the door.
hero3.hero-microproof: Exam · Digital X-rays · OralID screening · Treatment plan
hero3.urgent-note: you will not get a lecture. The practice is judgment-free and education-based: you get told what is going on and what the options are, and what happens next is your call.
hero3.hero-promise: $109 covers the whole first visit. No surprise add-ons on the day.
section5.h2: A first visit that actually tells you something.
section5.text: Not a five-minute look and a rebooking card. You leave knowing what is going on in your mouth, what needs doing, what can wait, and what it would cost.
section5.span5: Discussed with one of the doctors
section5.fine-print: $109 new patient special. New patients aged 18 and over; restrictions apply. An online request is not a confirmed appointment until the office speaks with you. Most dental insurance accepted, but not HMO or Medicaid.
section-navy6.text: General and family dentistry through to implants, veneers and full-mouth reconstruction, all at 6695 Wadsworth Blvd. If your first visit turns up something more involved, it gets done here rather than referred across town.
section7.benefit-text: Patients describe the practice as judgment-free. However long it has been, you get treated the same as anyone else.
section7.benefit-text2: You get told what is going on and what the options are. Nothing is booked on the day unless you want it booked.
section7.benefit-text3: Dr. Bennett is board certified to administer IV sedation and does so himself, for anyone the dentist frightens.
section7.benefit-text4: Implants, veneers, full-mouth restoration and an in-house lab, so treatment stays with one team.
section-sand8.h2: What treatment here can look like.
section-sand8.text: This clinical case is from Arvada Dental Center's official patient gallery. Your first visit starts with the exam and the plan. What follows is entirely your decision.
section9.eyebrow: YOUR FIRST VISIT, STEP BY STEP
section9.h2: Know what comes next before you book.
section9.journey-text: Request the special online or call. The office confirms the appointment with you and answers anything you want to ask first.
section9.journey-text2: A comprehensive exam and digital X-rays, plus an OralID oral cancer screening, so nothing is being guessed at.
section9.journey-text3: One of the doctors talks you through what is going on, what needs doing, and what can safely wait.
section9.journey-text4: Costs and options are on the table before anything is scheduled. Payment plans and financing are available if you are uninsured.

story.caption: This is a real Arvada Dental patient. He had not seen a dentist in nine years, expected a lecture, and was braced for bad news. Drag the slider to see where he is now.

story-before.text: Nine years since his last checkup
Putting it off because he expected judgment
A cracked filling he had learned to chew around
No idea what his insurance actually covered
Bounced between three offices for one problem

story-after.text: Back on a six-month schedule, no drama
Told exactly what things cost, upfront
Treated by the same dentist every visit
Not one word about the nine years

story.before-alt: Smile before dental implant treatment at Arvada Dental Center
story.after-alt: Patient's healthy smile after treatment at Arvada Dental Center

story-chapters.text: You move, your old dentist retires, or one bad experience puts you off. A year becomes five. Then finding a dentist starts to feel like something you need to prepare for.
story-chapters.alt: Dr. Kim listening to a patient at the first consultation

story-chapters.quote: “Nobody made me feel bad about it.”
story-chapters.text: A full exam, X-rays, and an honest conversation about where you actually stand. No lectures, no scare tactics, and no treatment plan you did not ask for.
story-chapters.alt: Digital X-rays and treatment planning at Arvada Dental Center

story-chapters.quote: “For once I knew what it would cost.”
story-chapters.text: If you need work, you get it in writing what it is, why it matters, what it costs, and what can safely wait. You choose the order.
story-chapters.alt: Calm, modern treatment room at Arvada Dental Center

story-chapters.quote: “Now it's just twice a year and done.”
story-chapters.text: Once you are caught up, staying there is easy. Same practice, same dentist, same team who know your history and a reminder when you are due.
story-chapters.alt: Patient's healthy smile after treatment at Arvada Dental Center

faq.q: Which insurance plans do you accept?
faq.a: We accept a wide range of insurance plans. During your first visit, all your clinical and financial questions will be answered.

faq.q: I don’t have Insurance, what do I do?
faq.a: No insurance? No problem. We have offers and payment plan options that will make your treatment very affordable.

faq.q: What is the new patient experience like?
faq.a: New patients will first do a comprehensive full-mouth examination. Then, the doctor will provide the treatment options.‍

We offer consultations that may be covered by insurance or provided at a reduced cost, depending on your coverage. We believe in the quality of our practice and are committed to providing exceptional service during these consultations.

faq.q: Do you have payment plan options?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely! We have payment solutions for all budgets. We make high quality dental care affordable.

faq.q: How many visits do I need to make?
faq.a: The number of visits depend on your case.‍

faq.q: How long will my treatment take?
faq.a: We do the full spectrum of dentistry. All treatments are done in-house.
